playbookOutputs: Official SARS Notice of Registration (IT150) showing the 10-digit Income Tax Reference Number
Activated SARS eFiling Profile / Registered Representative Link
playbookCommonFailures: Selfie holding ID and "For SARS Purpose" note is blurry or the ID number cannot be read in the photo
Individual already has a dormant historical SARS tax number linked to their ID number (requires eFiling profile recovery / IT150 retrieval rather than new registration)
Foreign passport holder does not provide a valid visa/work permit or local residential proof with CRA01

informationToProvide.label: Registration Type (Individual Taxpayer vs Registered Company) & Personal / Company Contact Details (Email, Cellphone, Physical Address)
informationToProvide.helpText: State whether this registration is for an Individual or a Company, and provide full contact email, cellphone number (for SARS OTP), and physical address.

informationToProvide.label: Certified SA ID or Passport Copy (Not Older Than 3 Months)
alternatives: Certified passport & valid visa/work permit (foreign nationals)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload a clear certified copy of the taxpayer (or Public Officer) SA ID or Passport (< 3 months).
informationToProvide.aiHint: Certified South African ID or Passport + valid visa/permit (if foreign national), certified within the last 90 days.

informationToProvide.label: Clear Photo (Selfie) of Taxpayer / Public Officer Holding Original ID & Handwritten Note Reading "For SARS Purpose" with Date
informationToProvide.helpText: SARS requires a clear photograph showing your face while holding your ID document and a handwritten note reading "For SARS Purpose" with the date.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Photograph of the individual holding their original ID card/book next to their face along with a piece of paper reading "For SARS Purpose" so both face and ID text are legible.

informationToProvide.label: Proof of Residential Address (Not Older Than 3 Months)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload proof of residential address dated within the last 3 months.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Utility bill, municipal account, bank statement, lease agreement, or SARS CRA01 form dated within 90 days confirming residential street address.

informationToProvide.label: Stamped Bank Confirmation Letter or 3 Months Bank Statements (Not Older Than 3 Months)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload an official bank confirmation letter or 3 months bank statements (< 3 months).
informationToProvide.aiHint: Official bank account confirmation letter or 3 months bank statements dated within 90 days showing the account holder name, account number, and branch code.

informationToProvide.label: CIPC Registration Certificate (CoR 14.3) — Required If Registering a Company
informationToProvide.conditionalQuestion: Are you registering a Company / Close Corporation for a SARS Income Tax number?
informationToProvide.helpText: If registering a company that did not automatically receive a SARS tax number from CIPC, upload its CoR 14.3 certificate.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Official CIPC CoR14.3 registration certificate showing enterprise registration number and registered name.

informationToProvide.label: Signed SARS Power of Attorney (SPPOA)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload the signed SARS Special Power of Attorney authorising My Accountant to register your tax number.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Signed SARS Special Power of Attorney (SPPOA) authorising My Accountant to act on the taxpayer behalf.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect certified ID, SARS selfie, proof of address, bank confirmation, and signed POA
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: All KYC documents, SARS selfie, bank confirmation, and contact details for OTP received
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Ensure the selfie clearly shows the taxpayer face, original ID, and handwritten "For SARS Purpose" note.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Verify KYC documents, bank confirmation, and check if a SARS tax number already exists
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: All uploads pass verification; SARS eFiling / SOQS checked for any existing tax reference number
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Check on SARS eFiling whether the ID number or CIPC registration number already has an issued 10-digit Income Tax number.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Submit SARS Income Tax Registration on SARS eFiling / SARS Online Query System (SOQS)
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: SARS tax registration submitted with all supporting documents and case number recorded
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Submit the registration via SARS eFiling or SARS Online Query System (Register for Income Tax) and upload the certified ID, selfie with note, proof of address, bank confirmation, and POA.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Wait for SARS to issue the IT150 Notice of Registration
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: SARS Notice of Registration (IT150) issued with 10-digit Income Tax number
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Monitor SARS case status or download the IT150 Notice of Registration from eFiling once issued.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver SARS IT150 Notice of Registration to the client portal
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Official SARS IT150 uploaded to Communication History
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Deliver the official SARS IT150 PDF and confirm the 10-digit Income Tax reference number.
